description: This is a test class for the gesture typing feature in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of gesture typing, including gesture recognition, suggestion output, handling of special keys, UI updates, and detector lifecycle management.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardGestureTypingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying gesture typing functionality in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It tests gesture recognition, suggestion output, detector lifecycle, UI updates, and edge cases.

methods.name: setUpForAnySoftKeyboardBase
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, enabling gesture typing and preparing the environment.

methods.name: tearDownDisposables
methods.description: Disposes of reactive subscriptions after each test.

methods.name: createLatestStateProvider
methods.description: Creates a supplier that provides the latest loading state of a gesture typing detector.

methods.name: testDoesNotOutputIfGestureTypingIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that no gesture output occurs when gesture typing is disabled in preferences.

methods.name: testDoesNotCallGetWordsWhenGestureIsOff
methods.description: Ensures that getLoadedWords is not called when gesture typing is off.

methods.name: testCallsGetWordsWhenGestureIsOn
methods.description: Ensures that getLoadedWords is called when gesture typing is enabled.

methods.name: testNotCrashingWhenExceptionIsThrownInGetWordsAndGestureIsOn
methods.description: Verifies robustness when getLoadedWords throws an exception.

methods.name: testOutputPrimarySuggestionOnGestureDone
methods.description: Checks that the gesture's primary suggestion is outputted after gesture completion.

methods.name: testDoesNotFailWhenInputConnectionReturnsNullAsTextInInput
methods.description: Simulates a dead input connection and verifies no crash occurs.

methods.name: testOutputCapitalisedOnShiftLocked
methods.description: Verifies output is uppercase when shift lock is active.

methods.name: testOutputTitleCaseOnShifted
methods.description: Verifies output is title case when shift is active.

methods.name: testCanOutputFromBothDictionaries
methods.description: Checks that suggestions can come from multiple dictionaries.

methods.name: testConfirmsLastGesturesWhenPrintableKeyIsPressed
methods.description: Verifies that last gestures are confirmed when a printable key is pressed.

methods.name: testOutputDoubleSpacesToDotAfterGestureIfEnabled
methods.description: Tests double space to period feature when enabled.

methods.name: testOutputDoubleSpacesToDotAfterGestureIfDisabled
methods.description: Tests double space to period feature when disabled.

methods.name: testDoesNotConfirmLastGesturesWhenNonePrintableKeyIsPressed
methods.description: Ensures gestures are not confirmed when a non-printable key is pressed.

methods.name: testConfirmsLastGesturesOnNextGestureStarts
methods.description: Verifies that gestures are confirmed when a new gesture starts.

methods.name: testDeleteGesturedWordOneCharacterAtTime
methods.description: Tests deleting a word gesture character by character.

methods.name: testRewriteGesturedWord
methods.description: Verifies rewriting a gesture-typed word with new input.

methods.name: testSpaceAfterGestureJustConfirms
methods.description: Checks that space after gesture confirms the word.

methods.name: testOnlySingleSpaceAfterPickingGestureSuggestion
methods.description: Ensures only one space is added after selecting a suggestion.

methods.name: testDoesNotOutputGestureWhenPathIsTooQuick
methods.description: Verifies no gesture output if gesture path is too quick.

methods.name: testDoesNotOutputGestureWhenPathIsTooShort
methods.description: Verifies no gesture output if gesture path is too short.

methods.name: testOutputsGestureIfPathIsJustLongEnough
methods.description: Checks that gesture output occurs when path length is just enough.

methods.name: testDeleteGesturedWordOnWholeWord
methods.description: Tests deleting an entire gesture-typed word.

methods.name: testShowClearGestureButton
methods.description: Verifies the clear gesture button becomes visible after a gesture.

methods.name: testHideClearGestureButtonOnConfirmed
methods.description: Verifies the clear gesture button hides after confirming gesture.

methods.name: testClearGestureButtonClearsGesture
methods.description: Tests that clicking the clear button clears the gesture.

methods.name: testHideClearGestureButtonOnClear
methods.description: Verifies the clear button hides after clearing gesture.

methods.name: testShowsTipOnSwipe
methods.description: Checks that a tip toast is shown when the swipe tip button is clicked.

methods.name: testClearAllDetectorsWhenCriticalAddOnChange
methods.description: Verifies detectors are cleared when add-ons change.

methods.name: testClearDetectorsOnLowMemory
methods.description: Ensures detectors are cleared on low memory conditions.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashIfOnLowMemoryCalledBeforeLoaded
methods.description: Verifies stability if onLowMemory is called before detector is loaded.

methods.name: testCreatesDetectorOnNewKeyboard
methods.description: Checks detector creation when a new keyboard is activated.

methods.name: getCurrentGestureTypingDetectorFromMap
methods.description: Retrieves the current gesture typing detector for the active keyboard.

methods.name: testBadgeGestureLifeCycle
methods.description: Verifies the lifecycle of gesture badge UI updates based on preferences.

methods.name: simulateGestureProcess
methods.description: Simulates a gesture path input for testing gesture recognition.
